_comment: Defines special test jobs that download the full build output of
artifact-producing build jobs (no rebuilding) and run the engine
Each job downloads the out/<config> directory tar uploaded by the
build job named in `downloads` (every build job uploads its build
output). The tested build's ninja targets must include
`flutter:unittests` so that the *_unittests binaries are present in
the build dir; run_tests.py then discovers and runs them (--type
For each entry in `tests`, run_tests.py runs with --variant, --type
The jobs below run the engine unittests for ci/host_debug on
linux/windows and for the debug/profile/release arm64 host builds

tests.name: Android Java unit tests for ci/android_debug_arm64
